verdict.rationale: Exporting records is a fair question for a government business-registry service. The Division lets users retrieve copies of their filed business documents, UCC financing statements and depository account statements online, and offers dissolution, cancellation or withdrawal as an exit path. It never describes a bulk export of all account data or says what file formats are used. Missing for 10: a documented complete export of all account and filing data, confirmation of open or machine-readable formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
